blocks.intro: The age of the housing shapes most of our calls.

items.body: Combined sewers fill fast in heavy rain.
Older homes have pipes on exterior walls and in crawl spaces.
A root-blocked line can back up on any day.

blocks.h2: What to Do Before We Arrive

steps.body: Usually in the basement where the water line enters.
If the leak is near it.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.h2: What You Get When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: Fast help and a price first.

blocks.body: The fastest way to limit water damage is knowing where to turn the water off. Your main shutoff is usually in the basement, on the wall where the water line comes in, near the meter. Each sink and toilet should have its own small valve. Water heaters have a valve on the cold line above the tank. Find them now, make sure they turn and show everyone in the house. In an emergency, those first minutes matter most.

Because the whole city is on combined sewers, heavy rain can push water back into basements quickly. If water starts coming up the floor drain, stop running water in the house so you're not adding to it. Move valuables up and keep people out of the water. Call us. Once the storm passes, we'll find out whether your lateral played a part and talk about protection.

blocks.h2: Emergency Plumbing Questions From Evanston Homeowners

items.answer: Yes. Our phone line is open around the clock.

items.q: Who do I call if I smell gas?
items.answer: Leave the house and call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside. We'll handle the repair once it's safe.

items.q: Will I know the price first?
items.answer: Yes. You'll approve a flat-rate price before work begins.

items.q: Should I shut off my water?
items.answer: If you can't stop a leak at the fixture, shut off the main valve.

items.q: How fast can you get here?
items.answer: Our office is downtown on Orrington Avenue, and we work to get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: My main shutoff won't turn. What do I do?
items.answer: Don't force it, since old valves can break. Call us and we'll replace it.
